title.zh: 同一批选票，不同的赢家 · 投票规则与公平
title.en: Same Ballots, Different Winner · Voting Rules and Fairness

desc.zh: 同一批选民的偏好，换一种数票的方法就换一个赢家。十一个可以动手的模型：搅局者、中位选民、多数循环、策略投票、阿罗定理、阿拉巴马悖论、画选区、陪审团定理。
desc.en: The same voters' preferences, counted another way, crown another winner. Eleven hands-on models: spoilers, the median voter, majority cycles, strategic voting, Arrow's theorem, the Alabama paradox, district lines and the jury theorem.

desc.zh: 相对多数、两轮决选、即时决选、波达计数和孔多塞两两对决，对同一批选票可以选出不同的赢家。
desc.en: Plurality, two-round runoff, instant runoff, Borda count and the pairwise Condorcet winner can pick different winners from the same ballots.

zh: 为什么换个算法赢家就变了
为什么投票结果不一样
en: why different voting systems give different winners

title.zh: 搅局者与无关选项独立
title.en: The spoiler effect and independence of irrelevant alternatives

desc.zh: 一个赢不了的候选人加入，就能把胜利从一个人手里交到另一个人手里。
desc.en: A candidate who cannot win can still hand victory from one rival to another.

desc.zh: 只看第一名的单议席选举里，选民会把三方竞争收缩成两方；这是倾向，不是定律。
desc.en: Under single-seat plurality voting, voters shrink a three-way race to two; a tendency, not a law.

desc.zh: 选民排在一条线上时，靠近中位选民的候选人一对一谁也赢不了；议题多于一个时这一点消失。
desc.en: On one line, the candidate nearest the median voter beats any rival head to head; with two issues that resting point disappears.

desc.zh: 每个人的排序都一致，多数人的偏好却可以 A 胜 B、B 胜 C、C 又胜 A。
desc.en: Each voter is consistent, yet the majority can prefer A to B, B to C and C to A.

title.zh: 策略投票与吉巴德–萨特斯韦特定理
title.en: Strategic voting and the Gibbard–Satterthwaite theorem

desc.zh: 三个以上候选人时，每种非独裁的规则都存在说假话更划算的局面。
desc.en: With three or more candidates, every non-dictatorial rule has situations where a dishonest ballot pays.

desc.zh: 没有哪种只看排序的规则能同时满足几条合理要求；每种规则都在某一条上让步。
desc.en: No rule that uses only rankings meets every reasonable condition at once; each gives way somewhere.

zh: 有没有公平的投票制度
有没有公平的投票方法
en: is there a fair voting system

title.zh: 席位分配与阿拉巴马悖论

desc.zh: 1880 年按最大余数法，众议院从 299 席加到 300 席，阿拉巴马反而少了一席。
desc.en: In 1880, under largest remainders, growing the House from 299 to 300 seats took a seat away from Alabama.

desc.zh: 同样的选民，只改选区边界，席位就能从 1 席变到 6 席。
desc.en: Same voters, redrawn lines: seats can swing from 1 to 6.

desc.zh: 每人略好于抛硬币且独立判断时，多数越大越可靠；略差于硬币或互相跟风时，结论反过来。
desc.en: If each voter is a little better than a coin and judges alone, bigger majorities are more reliable; if slightly worse or copying, it turns around.

en: is the majority more likely right

title.zh: 怎样读“这个制度很公平”
title.en: How to read a claim that a system is fair

desc.zh: 公平是一份清单：守住了哪几条，放弃了哪几条，放弃的那条会不会在你关心的情形里出事。
desc.en: Fairness is a checklist: which conditions a rule keeps, which it gives up, and whether that matters in your case.
